y-m-61-01.goal: Ta amfani da teburin ƙimomi, ka yanke hukunci cewa ko da mai ƙidaya da mai rarrabawa suna kusantar 0 yayin da x ke kusantar wata ƙima, iyakar na iya samuwa ko kuma ba ta samuwa; ka kuma bayyana yadda za ka bincika irin wannan magana idan ka ci karo da ita.
y-m-61-01.material:
Jiyeon ta ce, "Idan ka saka x=2, mai rarrabawa da mai ƙidaya duka za su zama 0, don haka 0/0 ne. Ba za a iya sanin ƙimar ba, saboda haka iyaka yayin da x ke kusantar 2 ma ba ta samuwa."
An duba ƙimomin ayyuka biyu kusa da x=2 (babu ɗayansu da aka ayyana a x=2).
f(x) = (x²−4)/(x−2), g(x) = (x−2)/(x−2)². (Ana karanta x² da 'x a murabba'i'. Ana lissafin waɗannan maganganu ne ga ƙimomin x waɗanda ba 2 ba.)

y-m-61-08.topic: Lissafin layin tangent: layin tangent da ke wucewa ta wurin da ba a kan lanƙwasa ba
y-m-61-08.goal: Lokacin nemo layukan tangent da ke wucewa ta wurin da ba ya kan lanƙwasa, ka fahimci dalilin da bai kamata a ɗauka x-coordinate na wurin shi ne na tangent ba; nemo x-coordinates na wuraren tangent da kanka, sannan ka nuna akwai layuka biyu masu yiwuwa.
y-m-61-08.material:
Akwai lanƙwasa y=x² (x murabba’i) da wuri A(1, −3). Muna son nemo layukan da ke wucewa A kuma suke tangent ga lanƙwasar.
Mafitar Hansol: “Derivative na y=x² shi ne 2x, saboda haka gangara a x=1 ita ce 2. Layi mai gangara 2 da ke wuce A shi ne y=2(x−1)−3=2x−5. Wannan shi ne layin tangent guda ɗaya.”

y-m-61-10.title: Za mu iya sa ƙimar iyaka 3 ta zama ƙimar numerator?
y-m-61-10.topic: Iyakokin ayyuka: iyakar gutsattsari mai denominator da ke kusantar 0, da ƙayyade coefficients
y-m-61-10.goal: Ka fahimci sharadin da numerator dole ya cika idan iyakar gutsattsarin da denominator ke kusantar 0 ƙayyadaddiyar ƙima ce, nemo layin mafita da ya gauraya ƙimar iyaka da ƙimar numerator, sannan ka gina ma’auratan (a,b) da ke ba da ƙimar iyaka L.
y-m-61-10.material: Ga constants a da b, a ɗauka (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) yana kusantar 3 yayin da x ke kusantar 1. (x²+ax+b: x murabba’i da ax da b; denominator x−1.) Yunseo ta yi ƙoƙarin nemo a da b kamar haka.
y-m-61-10.thinking.1: Kimanta dalilin da ya sa ake buƙatar sharadin
y-m-61-10.thinking.2: Gina misalai da nufin ƙimar iyaka
y-m-61-10.prereq.1: Ƙimar iyakar polynomial yayin x ke kusantar 1
y-m-61-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko marar daidai a mafitar Yunseo.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.hint.0: Kwatanta ko ƙarshe na layi na 2 da bayanin layi na 3 suna nufin abu ɗaya.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo a cikin sharadin asali wane bayani ne 3 yake zama ƙimar iyakarsa.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.0: Yayin x ke kusantar 1, ƙimar (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) tana kusantar 3.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.1: Denominator yana kusantar 0 amma gutsattsarin yana kusantar ƙayyadaddun 3, saboda haka numerator ma yana kusantar 0.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.2: Saka x=1 cikin numerator yana ba da 1+a+b, don haka 1+a+b=3.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka b=2−a, kuma numerator ya zama x²+ax+2−a.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.line.4: Duba ko wannan bayani yana rabuwa da (x−1) domin nemo a.
y-m-61-10.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Layi na 2 ya ce numerator yana kusantar 0, saboda haka 1+a+b dole ya zama 0. 3 ƙimar iyaka ce ta gutsattsarin gaba ɗaya, ba ƙimar numerator ba. A layi na 4 da 5, sa numerator ya zama 3 yana ba da bayani mai ƙima 3 idan x=1, kuma ba ya rabuwa da (x−1).
y-m-61-10.s.s2.prompt: Muna son bincika dalilin Yunseo a layi na 2. Idan numerator yana kusantar ƙayyadaddun ƙima marar sifili (misali 3) yayin da x ke kusantar 1, denominator kuma yana kusantar 0, me zai faru da ƙimar gutsattsarin?
y-m-61-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sanya 3 a matsayin mai lamba a sama, canza mai lamba a ƙasa zuwa 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, ka lissafta ƙimomin.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.hint.1: Duba kuma lokacin da mai lamba a ƙasa ke matsowa 0 daga gefen mara kyau.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.a: Cikakkiyar ƙimar tana ƙaruwa ba tare da iyaka ba, kuma ba ta matsowa lamba guda.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.a: Ka duba tasirin mai lamba a ƙasa yana matsowa 0 da kuma gaskiyar cewa mai lamba a sama ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.b: Mai lamba a ƙasa yana matsowa 0, saboda haka kaso ma yana matsowa 0.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.b: Yayin da mai lamba a ƙasa ke raguwa, kaso yana ƙaruwa. Idan mai lamba a sama 3 ne, a ƙasa kuma 0.01, menene ƙimar?
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.c: Yana matsowa ƙimar mai lamba a sama, 3, yadda yake. Mai lamba a ƙasa ba ya shafar ƙimar.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.c: Ka manta da tasirin rabo yana raguwa. Lissafta ƙimar kasonsa kai tsaye.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.o.d: Mai lamba a sama da na ƙasa suna motsi ta hanya ɗaya, don haka yana matsowa 1.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.r.d: Girman masu lamba a sama da ƙasa yana bambanta. Lissafta kai tsaye da wasu ƙimomi.
y-m-61-10.s.s2.explain: Idan mai lamba a sama yana kusa da 3, kuma mai lamba a ƙasa yana raguwa zuwa 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, ƙimar tana ƙaruwa zuwa kusa da 30, 300, 3000. Ba ta matsowa lamba guda. Don haka don ƙimar iyaka ta zama tsayayyiya, mai lamba a sama ma dole ya matsa 0.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.prompt: Da farko zaɓi ƙimar iyaka L, sannan nemo cikakkun lambobin a da b da za su ba ta. Shigar da nau’i-nau’i uku mabambanta (a, b, L), masu L mabambanta, ta yadda iyakar (x²+ax+b)/(x−1) yayin da x ke matsowa 1 ita ce L (cikakkiyar lamba tsakanin 1 da 5).
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta dangantakar a da b da za ta sa mai lamba a sama ya zama 0 idan x=1.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.hint.1: Saka wannan dangantaka cikin mai lamba a sama, fitar da (x−1) a matsayin abin ninkawa ka soke shi, sannan ka duba yadda ake rubuta ƙimar iyakar ta amfani da a.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c1: a, b, L cikakkun lambobi ne kuma L yana tsakanin 1 da 5 har da iyakokin.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c1: a, b, L dole su zama cikakkun lambobi kuma L ya kasance tsakanin 1 da 5 har da iyakokin.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c2: Mai lamba a sama 0 ne idan x=1, saboda haka za a iya soke shi.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c2: Mai lamba a sama ba 0 ba ne idan x=1. Dole mai lamba a sama ya zama 0 don a samu ƙima tabbatacciya.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.ok.c3: Ƙimar iyaka bayan sokewa, a+2, tana daidai da L.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.fail.c3: Ƙimar iyaka ba L ba ce. Rubuta mai lamba a sama a matsayin (x−1) ninkakkiyar wani furuci na layi, soke, ka nemo ƙimar iyaka.
y-m-61-10.s.s3.explain: Idan 1+a+b=0, to b=−1−a kuma x²+ax−1−a=(x−1)(x+1+a). Bayan sokewa, ana samun x+1+a, kuma iyaka yayin da x ke matsowa 1 ita ce a+2. Don haka L=a+2 da b=−1−a, kuma kowace L tana kayyade nau’i-nau’i guda (a,b).
